railzway.common.v1.Decimal.description:
Decimal is a canonical base-10 value. Scientific notation, leading plus
signs, and insignificant leading or trailing zeros are not allowed.

value.description: Canonical decimal representation, for example "0", "12.5", or "-0.01".

railzway.common.v1.Money.description: Money is an exact monetary value in an ISO 4217 currency.

amount.description: Exact amount in the specified currency.

railzway.payment.v1.ListPaymentAttemptsR.description: ListPaymentAttemptsResponse contains a page of payment attempts.

railzway.payment.v1.ListProviderConnecti.description: ListProviderConnectionsResponse contains a page of provider connections.

railzway.payment.v1.Payment.description:
Payment represents collection of the immutable outstanding amount of one
finalized invoice.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentAttempt.description: PaymentAttempt is an immutable record of one provider charge interaction.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentAttemptOutcom.description: PaymentAttemptOutcome describes the result of one provider interaction.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentFailureCatego.description: PaymentFailureCategory determines whether and how collection can continue.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentMethod.description:
PaymentMethod is a non-sensitive reference to a customer payment instrument
stored by one provider connection.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentMethodStatus.description: PaymentMethodStatus describes whether a stored method can be used.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentMethodType.description: PaymentMethodType identifies a provider-neutral payment instrument family.

railzway.payment.v1.PaymentStatus.description: PaymentStatus describes the collection lifecycle for an invoice.

railzway.payment.v1.ProviderCapabilities.description: ProviderCapabilities describes payment operations supported by a connection.

railzway.payment.v1.ProviderConnection.description:
ProviderConnection represents an organization's merchant account at a
payment provider. It never contains provider credentials.

railzway.payment.v1.ProviderConnectionSt.description:
ProviderConnectionStatus describes whether a merchant connection can route
new payments.

railzway.payment.v1.ProviderCredential.description:
ProviderCredential supplies an opaque credential during connection setup.
Implementations must consume it without persisting it in the API resource.

railzway.payment.v1.ProviderHealthStatus.description:
ProviderHealthStatus describes the observed runtime availability of a
provider connection without changing its administrative state.

railzway.payment.v1.RoutingPolicy.description: RoutingPolicy contains the ordered provider rules for an organization.

railzway.payment.v1.RoutingRule.description: RoutingRule defines provider priority for one eligibility scope.
